name: Solace Sauna
description:
Outside dimensions: Depth 72”, Width 84”, Height 84”. With ceiling overhang, O.D. is 77” Deep
Elegant curved overhanging ceiling on front, including exterior low-voltage puck lighting
Low voltage interior lighting, including color light therapy system
Contemporary European design with wall-to-wall and floor-to- ceiling glass on front sauna wall, including frameless door. All-glass front provides a warm glow when viewing from outside, and a panoramic view from inside
Clear Canadian Hemlock interior and exterior, combined with Abachi benches and backrests (Nordic White Spruce or Cedar also available)
Deco-style bench system with wall-to-wall middle platform; bench ends have integral armrests for added comfort
Bench layout is ideal for two people to lie down at the same time (4-6 seated)
As shown, sauna includes Vena heater series, but can be upgraded to Tonttu series
Options:

Bluetooth Sound System
